title: One For All Snitch
description: This lightweight utility automatically detects all active client mods and transmits the complete list directly to your server. It provides server administrators with full visibility into player configurations to easily monitor compatibility
body:
# 🕵️ One For All: Snitch

**One For All: Snitch** is a lightweight utility mod designed for server integrity and modpack synchronization. It acts as the client-side bridge for the **One For All: Sheriff** server plugin, ensuring that every player is running the intended environment.

---

## 🛠 What does it do?
The primary purpose of **Snitch** is transparency. Upon joining a server, the mod automatically compiles a list of your currently installed mods and versions, reporting them directly to the server's **Sheriff** plugin.

* **Automated Reporting:** No manual commands required; it works instantly upon connection.
* **Consistency Checks:** Helps server admins ensure all players are using the required performance mods or preventing blacklisted client-side cheats.
* **Lightweight:** Zero impact on FPS or game performance. It only runs during the initial handshake phase.

## 🔗 Requirements
This mod is part of the **One For All** ecosystem and requires a server-side component to function:
1.  **Client:** One For All: Snitch (this mod).
2.  **Server:** A Spigot/Paper/Velocity server running the **One For All: Sheriff** plugin.

> **Note:** If you join a server that does not have the Sheriff plugin installed, Snitch will remain idle and perform no actions.

## 📂 Installation
1.  Download the appropriate version for your mod loader (Forge/Fabric/NeoForge).
2.  Drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
3.  Connect to your favorite One For All-enabled server!

---

### 📜 Permissions & Modpacks
You are free to include **One For All: Snitch** in any modpack. No explicit permission is required, though a link back to this page is always appreciated!

*Found a bug? Report it on our **[Discord]**!: https://discord.gg/tTxyS2BRvE *
